description:
From the Ashes of Kobol
A Battlestar Galactica themed shipset
v.0.2.9
Not save compatible with pre-v.0.1.0

Made for Game Version: 0.97a-RC11
Tested only for that version

UPDATE NOTE:
If updating from v.0.1.0/1/2/3, then remove all mounted weapons on your BSG destroyers and frigates before updating.
I made some changes to weapon mounts on frigates and destroyers, including changing several to built-in weapons.
Failure to do so may break your save. This change occurred in v.0.1.4

DOWNLOAD LINK

Welcome to my attempt at bringing some of the world of Battlestar Galactica into Starsector.

This is currently a W.I.P. and doesn't feature any factions. I am open to suggestions and feedback as I continue to try and add content to this mod.

There will be two versions of this mod, a faction-based version and a version that is just a shipset. The former will include changes to descriptions and other changes to make it more in line with BSG canon, and will include a Colonial faction and a Cylon faction. The latter will just be everything except the factions; and all ships, weapons, and all other items will be obtainable via independent factions and mercenaries.

Right now, this mod is just a shipset.

FEATURES

Spoiler
- 20 Combat Ships: 5 Battlestars (Capitals), 5 Assaultstars (Cruisers), 5 Gunstars (Destroyers), 5 Gunstars (Frigates).
- 15 Civilian Ships: 3 Tankers, 5 Freighters, 6 Transports, 1 Salvage Rig
- 18 Combat Fighters: 6 Bombers, 3 Support Fighters, 5 Heavy Fighters, 4 Interceptors.
- 6 Obtainable Weapons: 1 Medium Kinetic Battery, 1 Medium Flak Cannon, 1 Small Kinetic Battery, 1 Small Flak Cannon, 1 Small Nuclear Missile Launcher, 1 Medium Nuclear Missile Launcher
- Several Unobtainable Weapons (Built-in).
- Unique Sounds: Weapon sfx taken from the shows.

LORE

Spoiler
FACTION VERSION:
Currently W.I.P

SHIPSET VERSION:
Welcome to the Colonial Defense Technology Corp. Portfolio! The CDTC is dedicated to engineering the best of ship technology for colonial expansion and exploration. Our ships are built to last, including redundant systems and hull plating that could take a nuclear barrage without a scratch. Our ships are also low maintenance, allowing you to venture further and further into the great unknown and restore humanity's grasp on the Persean Sector.

CDTC was established a generation ago on the belief that it is time for humanity to retake the Persean Sector. After the Domain's fall from power, dozens if not hundreds of habitable worlds now wait for recolonization. However, colonizing worlds is not a task for the faint of heart, nor is it free from danger. Pirates, supplies, hyperspace storms, and even rival colony organizations all threaten colony efforts. The CDTC was founded to design technology specifically designed to escort fleets of colony ships to their new homes, safe from all the dangers that might press against them.

The CDTC's crowning achievement is the Battlestar, a combat carrier designed to single-handedly lead colony fleets through the great unknown. These battlestars are large, efficient, and come packed with weaponry and hangars of fighter-craft. The battlestars were designed with the intention of being one-ship fleets, capable of scaring off or even decimating pirate raiders and other threats. Alongside the battlestars, our ship packages include cruiser sized assaultstars, and our smaller gunstars. Every ship has been engineered to serve your colonial interests and make certain your colonists make it home.

While it is true that some claim our ships are far too expensive despite being relatively low-tech in design, we at the CDTC argue that our ships are designed to last. Upfront costs are easily repaid in time with savings in supplies and fuel thanks to our efficient and reliable engineering. Also, who needs shields when you have more armor than a fully powered battle-station and thrusters so powerful you won't even notice the extra weight?

If you're interested in purchasing or renting the best in colony fleet defense, then look no further than Colonial Defense Technology Corp., your first stop for colonial warships!

MEDIA

Spoiler

CREDITS

Spoiler
All ship sprites are based on artwork created by the talented artist CanisD and also models by the Nightstalker's Universe team.

Unfortunately, it is rumored that CanisD passed away several years ago and his website, Wolf's Shipyard, shutdown. Luckily, however, with some web archive magic I was able to collect most of his BSG ship schematics and designs, allowing me a plethora of content to work with.

Each ship sprite has been cut, modified, shaded, and retextured, as to allow the models to better fit within the Starsector art style. However, despite my meticulous changes, I do not take credit for the original artwork created by either CanisD or the NSU team. Despite this, I do not give permission to use the sprites provided in this mod without permission. I will not be taking any kind of monetary reward for this mod, including donations, as such would be petty in light of the passing of CanisD.

Also, a special thanks to TrueAvarus (Of the UNSF Stargate Mod) for his Nuclear Missiles which I have incorporated a customized version of into this mod. He has also been an extreme help with learning how to mod Starsector.

Thanks also to everyone else who has been supportive and helpful as I have tried to overcome the learning curve of modding Starsector.

HOW YOU CAN HELP

Spoiler
If you would like to help me with this mod, please do not be afraid to comment down below your suggestions, feedback, and more! I am relatively new to Starsector, so my understanding of the game's fundamentals is still a bit fresh, and as such balancing is definitely a concern with this mod. If you see any bugs or typos, please let me know about them as well.

Suggestions on how to better balance the mod is paramount.

DEADLOCK?

Spoiler
Considering how much gets spoken about Deadlock, I felt I would make a quick pre-emptive response.

I will not be using any assets from Deadlock for two reasons:

1. The developers and publishing company are extremely restrictive when it comes to in game assets. Take Stellaris, wherein numerous people have attempted to make shipset mods using Deadlock assets, all of which have been taken down within weeks of publishing. Do I think Deadlock's publishers are petty enough to take down a mod that souly uses top-down low-res screenshots of their ships? Yes. Yes I do.

2. I already tried and failed. I hadn't actually purchased the game, and decided it was worth exploring as an option for this mod a few weeks ago, so I did buy it. However, after banging my head for 24 hours straight, using paid Unity-ripping tools and other methods of trying to get good quality images of the models, I failed to accomplish anything. So, I refunded the game and gave up.

I am not against using Deadlock for inspiration or for balancing comparisons. Those of you who have played the game extensively are welcome to make suggestions in the comments down below. I would, however, point you to the CREDITS section, wherein I would like to re-iterate that I am not an artist, nor am I the original creator of the source art used to create the sprites in this mod. If your suggestion is to create a ship based on a unique design in Deadlock, I am afraid I just don't have the skills necessary to pull such off.

CHANGELOG

Spoiler
v.0.2.9
- Fixed the Berzerk Transport sprite.

v.0.2.8
- Added new Berzerk Troop Carrier.

v.0.2.7
- Reduced max hull on capitals.
- Adjusted flux dissipation on several Cruisers better fitting to number of weapon slots.
- Slightly reduced torpedo/missile top speed, made launch speed about 0.25 of max speed.
- Slightly decreased torpedo/missile health.
- Changed Astral Queen class variant name from Liner to Freighter.

v.0.2.6
- Slightly decreased missile/torpedo health in favor of higher speed.
- Fixed download link in Version Checker.

v.0.2.0
- Added new Colonial civilian ships.
- Made it so PD weapons now also target fighters.
- Made some other minor adjustments to weapon hints/tags.
- Lowered replacement time on most fighters and bombers.
- Added unique projectiles for each size of nuclear missile/torpedo, including scaling damage radius.
- Lowered max crew on all military ships, but also decreased min crew on larger ships.
- Increased armor on all fighters and bombers.
- Increased flux on all Heavy Fighters.
- Made variant sound effect for Spinal Cannons. Deeper and louder.
- Made it so nuclear weapons won't hit friendly ships.
- Added version checker support.

v.0.1.4
- Increased flux dissipation on all ships.
- Increased speed of all heavy fighters, bombers, and support fighters.
- Increased armor and hit-points of all heavy fighters, bombers, and support fighters.
- Returned flayer launcher to all heavy fighters and bombers.
- Added Colonial Flag and Crest.
- Majorly increased repair/supply rate to increase estimated combat value. Matched fleet points to the new values.
- Adjusted position of Gremlin's guns. Made many of the ships forward weapon mounts hidden and built-in with nuclear missile launchers.
- Added additional hull-mods to all ship variants, gave variants flux capacity and vent capacity points. Set up variant weapon groups.
- Slightly increased OP cap on capitals.

v.0.1.3
- Added missile launcher graphics.
- Decreased size of Viper Torpedo sprite.
- Increased time to regenerate nuclear torpedoes/missiles, decreased projectile hitpoints. Increased launch speed.
- Decreased weapon range and increased overall weapon firing speed.
- Added limited ammo to nuclear weapons but increased projectile speed and hitpoints.
- Removed vanilla ship class names (battlecruiser, light carrier, etc.).
- Decreased fighter range.
- Replaced flayers with maneuvering jets on all fighters and bombers. Support fighters still have flayers.
- Fixed AI not using nuclear weapons. Fixed the AI hints and removed charge-up.
- Reduced weapon flux usage.

v.0.1.2
- Fixed Amphilochus having a fighter bay when it shouldn't.
- Decreased effect radius of nuclear missiles. Might help prevent friendly fire issues wiping out entire fleets of friendly smaller ships.
- Increased flux usage of weapons.
- Increased hull hitpoints on most ships.
- Decreased max flux capacity on all ships.
- Decreased damage and refire rate to most weapons in favor of longer range.
- Increased max speed on all ships, but decreased acceleration and turn rate.
- Adjusted sound pitch variance. Should help make mass firing weapons less annoying to listen to for long durations.

v.0.1.1
- Increased armor on destroyers and frigates.
- Increased top speed of all ships by 5.
- Added weapons and wings to all variants, enemies should now spawn with weapons on their ships.
- Added two new weapons, a small and medium nuclear missile launcher. These items are obtainable, but do not have custom sprites yet.
- Increased how common BSG ships are in stores and fleets.

v.0.1.0
Initial Release, see features.

TO-DO LIST

Spoiler
This to-do list is in no particular order nor are any listed items promised to be in the next update. It is simply my tracker for things I intend to eventually add or change.

- Add custom player flags.
- Add Colonial Decal to all ships that don't already have it.
- Add Cylon military and civilian ships.
- Add Colonial civilian ships.
- Rescale all ships and weapons.
- Add factions.
- Improve nuclear missile/torpedo trail effects.
